adjacent_pose_delta_summary.note: ImageChops RGBA mean-delta run over adjacent normalized transparent frames; zero pairs would indicate duplicate frame images.

runtime_import_policy.applies_to: v2 soldier animation atlases and frame PNGs
runtime_import_policy.bleeding_mitigation: Mipmaps disabled and wrap mode clamped for exact 256x256 atlas tiles without gutters. If mipmaps/minified texture sampling are later required, repack with 2-4 px extrusion before integration.
runtime_import_policy.mobile_memory_note: Keep separate player/enemy atlases for M01. Each 4096x1792 RGBA atlas is large but acceptable for a pre-integration M01 import pass with explicit max size and no implicit NPOT scaling; split by state/faction later if runtime memory profiling requires it.

atlas_layout_policy.layout: separate faction atlases, exact 256x256 tiles, 16 columns
atlas_layout_policy.repack_trigger: Only repack to 4096x2048 or state-split atlases if PM/user requires mipmaps, if QA detects edge bleed, or if mobile memory profiling rejects the two-atlas layout.
